TestLwtDestructiveDDL::test_drop_table.description: 3-node cluster (3 racks), 4 LWT threads (INSERT IF NOT EXISTS / UPDATE IF / DELETE IF EXISTS, also as single-statement batches; prepared lazily, retried) on nodes 1,2,3,1 while 4 threads loop DROP TABLE + CREATE TABLE ks.test with 0.1s pauses for 30s (90s debug). Asserts no worker died (future.result()), nodes live, LWT and DDL each succeeded at least once, and no unexpected log ERRORs (expected: no_such_column_family, mutation write failures, CAS prune failures). Guards against crashes when paxos/prune hits a dropped table.
